# Asset inventory and requirements

All current visual assets are original SVG concept illustrations generated by `scripts/build.mjs`. They do not use Timbur or other third-party product imagery.

## Generated files

- `assets/renders/dekara-pedestal-<timber>-<cabinet>-<handle>-1200.svg` — 16 finish combinations from `data/products/dekara-pedestal.json`.
- `assets/renders/dekara-pedestal-<timber>-<cabinet>-<handle>-1200-<view>.svg` — four gallery views for each combination.
- `assets/renders/studio-modules.svg`, `revit-family.svg`, `shop-drawing.svg`, `ar-model.svg` — original concept diagrams.
- `assets/renders/og-cover.svg` — social preview placeholder.
- `assets/downloads/sample-shop-drawing.svg`, `sample-cut-list.csv`, `project-brief-template.txt` — sample concept resources.
- `assets/site.js`, `assets/product-viewer.js`, `assets/chunk-*.js` — generated, minified browser entry points and on-demand chunks.
- `assets/site.css` — local, system-font styling.

The product's variant naming convention is `dekara-pedestal-<timber>-<cabinet>-<handle>-1200.svg`, corresponding to the selected option IDs. Example: `dekara-pedestal-oak-chalk-brass-1200.svg`.

## Required owner assets before launch

- Owner portrait: `assets/img/me.avif`, `me.webp` and/or `me.jpg`, 4:5 crop with verified alt text.
- Product imagery: one lifestyle render and four white-backdrop views per real product, plus render coverage for each published option combination.
- 3D: owner-created optimized GLB (target under 3–5 MB) and pre-built USDZ for iOS Quick Look; list sizes and alt text.
- Video: owner-produced, captioned MP4/WebM with a poster; load on demand.
- Downloads: owner-created `.rfa`, spec sheet, production-ready PDF, quote/cut-list example, GLB/USDZ and QR sheet.
- Brand assets, favicon, verified Open Graph image, and any approved case-study images.

No uploaded file manager or automated image/model transcoder exists in this phase. Do not place LFS-pointer GLBs, former-employer work, Timbur assets or unlicensed files in this folder.
